title: Fence staple, withdrawn from a post
summary: Held a wire for an estimated sixty years, and had grown a considerable amount of post around itself in the process.

body.text: The post had rotted to the point where it could be pulled apart by hand. The staple came away with a plug of wood still gripped in its jaw, the fibres having grown around and then given up.

Somebody stood on this line, in weather that is not materially different from today's weather, and drove this in with a hammer, and then walked on and drove in the next one, and the one after that, for as long as the boundary took.
